tools.name: scan_url
tools.description: Run ShipLatch's free passive security scan on a public web app URL (for example a Lovable, Bolt, Replit or Cursor app). Read-only: it fetches the page and its public JS like a browser would and never logs in, submits forms or tests exploits. Returns the grade, issue counts and the type of each issue

tools.name: get_scan
tools.description: Get the free summary of a ShipLatch scan by its scan_ref (from scan_url). Use it when scan_url returned status "running". Results are kept for 7 days.

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: List the categories of security checks ShipLatch runs, which are in the free passive scan and which need ownership verification. No network access.
